items.headline: Manchester United face Brighton in Carabao Cup
items.summary: United prepare to face Brighton having lost their previous cup match. Michael Carrick focused on returning to winning form.

items.headline: Carlos Baleba trains at Carrington
items.summary: Manchester United midfielder Carlos Baleba returned to team training after recent absence, boosting Michael Carrick's midfield options.

items.headline: Academy players offered professional contracts for 2026/27
items.summary: Manchester United hand out three professional contracts to academy players ahead of the 2026/27 season.
